annotations.title: Turn Dedicated Server DDoS Protection On or Off

description: Toggle DDoS protection for a dedicated server. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

enabled.description: Target state (true = protected). Without it the current state is flipped.

serviceId.description: ID of the Dedicated server: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_dedicated_servers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: toggle_dedicated_ddos_protection
title: Turn Dedicated Server DDoS Protection On or Off
